title: Commerce Operations Platform

domain.name: commerce
domain.summary: A platform that coordinates finite inventory, checkout, payment, fulfillment, support, and operational recovery.

product.goal: Let customers purchase limited inventory safely while giving operators enough control and evidence to recover from failures.

architecture_baseline.summary: A single-region modular monolith with a PostgreSQL system of record and external payment integration.
data_stores: PostgreSQL for inventory, reservations, orders, and audit history
architecture_baseline.deployment: single region with independently restartable application and worker processes

base_business_rules: Confirmed orders must not exceed fulfillable inventory.
A payment event must not create more than one business transition.
Operators need correlation and state history for financial recovery.
base_constraints: Payment callbacks may be duplicated, delayed, or delivered out of order.
The MVP team prefers the least complex architecture that protects current invariants.

evolution_history.summary: Initial project baseline proposed for the learning program.
